content:
Alongside Amazon’s now live early Black Friday sale, it has also brought back its discount on the new Apple TV 4K for release day with much faster shipping times than Apple for most folks, alongside all-time low pricing on AirTag 2 at $17.50 each, AirPods Pro 3 deal at $50 off, and Apple Watch Ultra 4 at nearly $100 off. However, Amazon has also now brought back the deep clearance deal on Apple Watch Ultra 3 configs at $250 off the list price and is now delivering even more color options on the major M5 MacBook Air deals at $250 off. Head below for a closer look.

Amazon delivers release day discount on new Apple TV 4K

As of the time of writing, Amazon is still delivering the brand new Apple TV 4K down at $289.99 shipped.

  • NEW Apple TV 4K $289 (Reg. $299)

That’s clearly not a massive deal and you could just score the new Siri Remote for a fraction of the price to upgrade your existing Apple TV, but the deal is indeed live as of this morning for release day.

Best Buy updates giant early Black Friday deals with new 3-day Doorbuster sale: Apple, TVs, smart home, PS5 storage, more

PSA: Watch out for today’s new Doorbusters, Amazon still has the best deals on AirPods (Up to $100 off)

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (Reg. $549)

Don’t need four of them? Single AirTag 2 now down at $23 Amazon all-time low

The Amazon early Black Friday deals are flying and we are catching some seriously great official Apple accessory deals, from nearly 25% off Magic Mouse to a collection of official Apple Watch bands at up to 34% off, and even Apple Magic Trackpad all-time lows. The most notable of which for me, however, has to be the AirTag 2 deals. Not only can you score the 4-pack back at the lowest price ever, but the single listing is now sitting at the $23 Prime shipped all-time low.

Early Black Friday AirTag 2 deals

  • 1-pack AirTag 2 $23 (Reg. $29) – NEW all-time low
  • 4-pack AirTag 2 $70 (Reg. $99) – Matching all-time low

While the 4-pack offer is the better overall value for sure, some folks just don’t need four or the $70 expense, despite the all-time low pricing there.

The single is, fortunately, also sitting at its best price ever down at $23 with free shipping for Prime members or in orders over $35.

Rare deal hits Apple Pencil Pro today (Nearly 35% off), iPhone Duo-ready model still at $69

The Amazon early Black Friday sale is really flying now, but we are, however, popping over to Woot this morning to scope out a rare chance at savings on Apple Pencil Pro at nearly 35% off the list price. It’s really all about the iPhone Duo-compatible Apple Pencil USB-C right now (you can still score a deal over at Amazon), but if you have been waiting on a chance at a deal on Apple Pencil Pro, we have one today.

We also still have AirTag 2 at $17.50, the latest AirPods Pro 3 at a solid $50 off the list price, and the Apple HomeView deal still rolling for release day, but let’s scope out some Pencil deals too:

Apple Pencil Pro is not iPhone Duo compatible like the USB-C model at $69, but it is still, otherwise, the most feature-rich and powerful model in the lineup. It almost never drops below the $99 we have right now in brand new condition at Amazon right now, but Woot will deliver you a “New-Open Box” unit for $84.99 Prime shipped today.

It is perhaps not ideal for some, but it does ship with a 90-day warranty and it is the lowest price we have tracked in a long while. If you have a digital artist on your list, or are perhaps looking to land something to elevate your iPad experience this holiday, there’s no telling if we will get anything better than $99 on brand new condition units for Black Friday.

Deep clearance deal on Apple Watch Ultra 3 now live at $250 off, Ultra 4 configs at $100 off

Alongside the early Black Friday sale at Amazon and Apple Watch Ultra 4 at nearly $100 off, the particularly notable clearance deal on the most gorgeous Apple Watch Ultra 3 is back at $250 off.

There are some great Ultra 4 deals flying right now with return lows across a number of configurations at nearly $100 off. This is the lowest price we have tracked on all of them since release in September and, if history is any indication, about as low as they will get this year.

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 Black Milanese $649 (Orig. $899)
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 4 Milanese Loop $799 (Reg. $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 Natural Milanese $649 (Orig. $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 4 Milanese Loop $799 (Reg. $899)

That said, and considering how great Apple Watch Ultra 3 still is, landing a major $250 price drop on last year’s model is a compelling proposition. I still wear my Natural Titanium Ultra 2 to this day, and it looks and works just as good as it always has, but these Milanese Loop Ultra 3 models at price a whole lot lower than we will see on the Ultra 4 until around this time next year are calling my name.

If you are, however, set on scoring the latest model, check out the configs at nearly $100 off below instead:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 4 Burgundy Trail $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 4 Burgundy Alpine $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 4 Translucent Gray Ocean $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 4 Desert Alpine $699 (Reg. $799)

M5 MacBook Air best price in months: Up to $250 off in early Black Friday sale (Additional colors now live)

Alongside the return of all-time low pricing on AirTag 2 at $17.50, one of the best early Black Friday Apple deals we have tracked this year so far has to be the latest M5 MacBook Air at up to $250 off the list price. 

Deals on MacBook Air have been somewhat underwhelming since the price increase early this past summer, but the deals are now flying:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (Reg. $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,349 (Reg. $1,599) – $250 off
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,599 (Reg. $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,299 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,549 (Reg. $1,799) – $250 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,799 (Reg. $1,999)

As you can see above, we are looking at the lowest price in nearly 5 months on on all colors of the most affordable model in the lineup down at $1,099 – this same price from the Apple refurbished store was notable a couple months back…but not anymore. You can score this popular M5 Air at $200 off right now in brand new condition.

However, it is the 16TGB/1TB models in both the 13-inch and 15-inch form-factors carrying the deepest $250 discount. While it wouldn’t be odd to see Amazon deliver deeper deals on the most expensive machines throughout the year, things have changed since the price increases and we are getting that sweet mid-range model with an impressive $250 price drop here as part of the early Black Friday sale. -range model with an impressive $250 price drop here as part of the early Black Friday sale.
